Narrative steep side view beside a huge leaning stone weight. Plácido has bent his tall rigid body down and jams his broad calcified palm against a shifted carved stone block to force it back into exact alignment, ash-grey back braid sliding forward with effort. Pale-red eye looks DOWN at the misaligned stone seam, jaw tight with angry obsessive concentration, shoulder and elbow show actual load, knees bend for weight. Not a ceremonial ruler portrait. The block is rough ancient stone, not a control panel or machine; no glowing writing, only old worn straight grooves. Alone.
